digest.en: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle, dominates headlines in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where a new Ebola vaccine trial has launched to combat the spreading outbreak. Meanwhile, the US and Iran are reportedly close to a deal to secure the Strait of Hormuz by August 5.
